Senses.Explanation: A snowflake entering a red-hot furnace vanishes without residue. Collected verses use that instantaneous disappearance to cap a case; Sanyi Mingyu makes it a condition maintained throughout the day, while Xilin Xuansu applies it to the rapid give-and-take of Dongshan-style exchanges. Complete-unit reading distinguishes original utterance, later raising, verse/commentary, biography, and paratext, and controls duplicate recensions at the deployment-family level.
